The first conversation is about direction, not destinations. We look at what you have studied, what you have done since, and what you want the next few years to lead to.

Getting this stage right is what makes every later decision — country, institution, programme — follow from something rather than from a brochure.

name: Institutional Services
summary: Helping academic and professional institutions overseas build relations with institutions in India, and vice versa.
description:
We help institutions initiate academic and professional contacts across borders.

**Institutional tie-ups.** We engage higher education institutions in India and around the world to foster and enhance links among them — through collaborative research, study abroad programmes, faculty exchanges, and seminars for higher education administrators from participating countries.

**Study exchange programmes.** We guide students and institutions in facilitating student exchange: helping students find global institutions to study at under exchange programmes, and helping institutions find students who can benefit from what they offer.

**Study tours.** We guide and facilitate academic tours abroad, generally lasting seven to eleven days. They include visits to educational institutions, so students can learn about courses and requirements, see life in and around campuses, explore employment opportunities and understand the culture and society of the destination. These tours are generally self-funded.

**International cell.** We assist international schools and colleges in expanding opportunities beyond their academic confines, with in-house counselling and support for their students.
howWeHelp: Institutional tie-ups: collaborative research, faculty exchanges and administrator seminars
Study exchange programmes for both students and institutions
Academic study tours of seven to eleven days, generally self-funded
